findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 4 projects, synced last week." but the list shows only 3 items (Holiday Campaign Assets, Support Backlog Triage, Mobile App Revamp)
findings.fix: Either add the fourth project to the list or change "4 projects" to "3 projects"
findings.violation: The text claims 4 projects but only 3 are displayed in the project list.

findings.evidence: The form contains an email input with a submit button labeled "Save", followed by a separate anchor link with id="invite-member-continue-link" that says "Continue"
findings.fix: Remove either the form's submit button or the Continue link to clarify the workflow, and ensure the remaining element handles the invitation submission clearly.
findings.violation: The form has both a submit button and a separate navigation link, making the user interaction unclear - it is ambiguous whether clicking Save submits the form or if the user must click Continue afterward.

findings.evidence: The select element for digest frequency contains options for "Daily", "Weekly", and "Monthly", but no option has a "selected" attribute
findings.fix: Add selected="selected" or the selected attribute to one of the option elements to indicate the current default setting.
findings.violation: The default selected value is not specified, so users cannot determine what the current notification frequency setting is before making changes.

findings.evidence: The text contains curly quotation marks around "Q3 Roadmap": "Archiving "Q3 Roadmap"..." and ""Q3 Roadmap" has been moved..."
findings.fix: Replace the curly quotation marks with straight ASCII quotation marks: "Q3 Roadmap"
findings.violation: Smart quotes (curly quotes) may not render correctly across all systems and browsers, or may be inconsistent with the rest of the interface which does not use smart quotes.
